title: Fort Collins, CO — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Fort Collins, CO: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Fort Collins is a city in CO with a population of 170,000. College town with Colorado State University, craft breweries, and mountain access. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.6.
